statement_en: Let \(\{f_n\}\) be a sequence of Lebesgue measurable functions such that \(\|f_n\|_{L^1(\mathbb{R})} \leq \frac{1}{4^n}\). Prove that \(f_n(x) \to 0\) almost everywhere.
callout_body: Lebesgue可测函数列$||f_n||_{L^1(\mathbb{R})}\leq \frac{1}{4^n}$证明$f_n(x)$几乎处处收敛到0。
